ar_gunslinger_boulder.blurb: Gunslinger Boulder is a single compact boulder in the Lone Wadi zone of northeast Arkansas, holding five problems and nothing else. The face is steep and overhanging, with a pocketed, powerful style that leans on dynos, deadpoints and sit starts. Difficulty is lopsided: one moderate line around V3, a pair at V4, then two much harder problems at V7 and V10, so it suits climbers who are already comfortable on steep ground. Bring pads for a short visit to this one stone rather than a circuit.

ar_colossus_boulder.blurb: Colossus Boulder is one large block on the valley floor at Horseshoe Canyon Ranch in north-central Arkansas, passed on the way toward the Upper Edens. It carries five established problems: a single easy line at V0, a pair around V4 and a pair at V5, so it fits climbers past the beginner stage looking for a few solid problems rather than a long circuit. The block stands roughly 100 feet off the dirt road, close to a faint fork in it, and the walk there heads downhill from the ranch's trading post.
